verdict.rationale: Northwest Registered Agent is a registered-agent and business-formation service, not an automation or workflow platform. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-built automations is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence suggests it ships such automations. The probe hit a Cloudflare challenge, so there is no first-party corpus, and the only community item is about its SEO, so neither speaks to automations.
